run_audiodec_encode_decode: run AudioDec to encode and decode a WAV audio file using a specified model
run_audiodec_gpu_inference: run AudioDec inference on GPU with a Libritts model and input WAV file
run_audiodec_cpu_inference: run AudioDec inference on CPU with cuda set to -1 for audio processing
run_audiodec_model_selection: run AudioDec with a chosen model like libritts_v1 or libritts_sym for audio compression
run_audiodec_thread_config: run AudioDec with custom thread count and CUDA device for audio encode/decode
